signal_actions.name: Start
signal_actions.description: Start the 1.0.80 release using compiled defaults or cap_init/trading_amount/min_tp_percent/strategy overrides. Stairs uses LevelExit and follows the calculated level stop. MRC Reclaim uses VirtualTrailingExit with a static level stop and moves TP by 2 ticks after it is crossed.

params.name: Initial budget %
params.description: Percent of max_amount reserved for the internal trading budget.

params.name: Trading amount %
params.description: Normal entry size as a percent of the deployable budget. Clamped to 10-100.

params.name: Minimum TP %
params.description: Minimum structural TP distance. The larger of this value and the cascade average is used.

params.name: Strategy
params.description: Choose the existing Stairs strategy or MRC Reclaim. The selection takes effect on Start.
